GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled touch Worse than midfield rails 12 Lengths 1600m, still well back in second half 13 Lengths 800m, off fence from the 600m but scrubbed along to chase Tearaway Leader , did keep grinding away under Hard Ridden in Straight but just held ground last 100m # grinding run
Jumped Ok Settled in 6th 6 Lengths . Straightened Up in Clear 3 Lengths off, Battled On Well only just missing a place # honest effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: laid in under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to 2nd 1 length . Leader went 5 Lengths Clear midrace. Straightened Up within 2 Lengths of tiring Leader , loomed up Soon After , no match for the winner who went Quickly on by, this faded to miss a place # did the chasing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: RR that in her opinion the mare is better suited on softer tracks.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Took A Sit 4th on rail 4 Lengths . travelled well to turn Straightening Up 2nd 3 Lengths from the Leader /winner, chased gamely eating into the margin (gap back to 3rd) # closed well/1st led

Jumped Ok Settled Just Off Mid-Field Wide With Cover 7 Lengths . began to work forward out Wide coming To The Turn , Took Lead Soon After Straightening Up & dashed away for an easy win under 51kg # good ride & win
Jumped Ok Settled in 6th 4 Lengths . scouted Wide on Turn but not Wide enough, 1st 2 home were out wider, she Battled On Well to finish 3rd # honest effort
Jumped Ok Settled Just Off Mid-Field 7 Lengths . pushed Clear on Turn , ran on well with one on her Outside , Battled On Well going to the line in a headbobber # got the bob in

Jumped Ok , Not Bustled Mid Field Two Wide 5 Lengths 1000m, Ridden Along before the corner and she looked to be battling, once balanced-up in Straight she picked up and really let down last 200m when given a reminder, took over last 75m and won with something in hand # strong late to win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , enjoyed good trail Two Wide With Cover behind speed 2 Lengths 1000m, Ridden Along from the corner and did not finish off # only battled late
Jumped Ok Settled Just Off Mid-Field Wide With Cover 7 Lengths . worked forward on Turn Straightening Up in Middle Of Track 2 Lengths off, chased gamely taking Lead late # Finished Too Well

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (ex brenton jones. Blinkers off, visors on) jumped awkwardly ended up 2nd last 6 Lengths . held up on Turn , Hooked Out Wide in Straight & ran on for 4th (winner led) # finished off ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up from rounding the home turn until its shifted wider  approaching the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok raced keenly in 5th in between runners 4 Lengths . became held up approaching home turn , got Clear on Straightening Up but had nothing to offer (vet - no visible abnormalities) # weak when counted
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event. Held up  from the 500m until the entrance to the home straight. RR she was unable to improve from the 600m after being held up on the heels of a/r which was commencing  to give ground until the 300m and when placed under pressure in straight, did not let down as  anticipated and was disappointing to the finish. Vet NVA.
